best: The 3V3 rail and MCU sheets are clean wired drawings with a left-to-right buck path, decoupling and pull-ups at their pins, and helpful notes on design intent.
worst: USB sheets lean on labels: the connector, TPD6S300, TPS25751 and EEPROM blocks hang off net-name stubs with almost no wires between them, plus a floating Q409, and the page has a large empty middle
Small-text clutter on the USB sheets: pin numbers overlap on the U401/U405 GND pins, labels crowd the IC pins, and the charger's long parallel buses to the sense/divider parts must be traced by eye
On Cells and Gauge, the TS/NTC area is scattered: long vertical wires down to off-board connectors, a thermistor value overlapping its symbol, and loose J-pads tied only by CELL_1N labels
